Pros: The dentist is kind and dedicated to treatment.
Cons: Lack of flexibility; focused on achieving perfect treatment. For example, what should have been just two cavities might result in an estimate of eight cavities, with no possibility of dispute. What should have been just one side of the mouth might end up needing fillings on two or three sides, only to realize later when paying the bill that the costs are escalating and the treatment is seemingly endless. It takes time to compare prices with other clinics to understand that simply adding two more cavities (on one side) would have solved the problem, and the eight cavities that were initially estimated are not even mentioned.
In summary, sometimes patients know which teeth are actually decayed, but the dentist fills almost all the cavities unnecessarily, leaving the patient to pay without knowing what else to do.
